notes: Mid-market B2B analytics vendor. Product team (CTO + 2 PMs) ran hosted API trial Jan-Feb 2026. Primary workload: agent-support (multi-turn), thin semantic search across product docs, and a small reranking pipeline for search results. Trial summary: responsiveness ok for short-turn chat; cold-start for long context hurts 95th%-tile latency. Cost sensitivity: high; want predictable commit for Dedicated. Security: must sit inside customer VPC for PII-sensitive features; SOC2 required. Quote from CTO: "We liked the latency/cost trade off when caching was on — but need clear guardrails for peak days."

recent_metrics: 30-day hosted trial: 420k total tokens/day peak, average 95k tokens/day
Average request size: ~180 tokens (prompt+response), median 64 tokens
Observed QPS (hosted): baseline 3 req/s, daily peak bursts to 28 req/s (short spikes)
Latency: p50 ~180ms, p95 ~1.2s on hosted; p95 improved to ~450ms with prefix cache in POC run
qps_forecast: Customer wants baseline capacity to comfortably handle 12 QPS sustained with headroom to 120 QPS peak (burst traffic during product launches). They expect concurrency of ~40-60 concurrent requests during peaks. Forecast assumes continued usage growth of 1.5x next 6 months after launch of chat feature.
token_mix: From hosted telemetry: ~60% of requests <=64 tokens (short chats), ~30% 65-512 tokens (doc lookup / summarization), ~10% >512 tokens (long summarization / multi-doc synth). Expected monthly tokens for production: ~1.0-1.4B tokens (varies with adoption).
capacity_recommendation: Initial Dedicated pool recommendation: start with 3 mid-tier GPUs (NVIDIA A10-equivalent) with autoscale policy to add 3 more during peak events. Rationale: this sizing supports estimated sustained 12 QPS with batching + KV cache and covers 120 QPS short bursts when autoscale kicks in. Include prefix caching for product-docs to reduce token compute on repeated queries; enable continuous batching with 50ms max latency window. Pricing model proposed: monthly reserved capacity + burst credits. Expect cost reduction ~35% vs hosted at current load if caching and batching applied.
poc_status: Hosted trial complete; POC validated latency/cost baselines. Next step is sizing for Dedicated and produce an SOW. Security intake: SOC2 questionnaire in progress; needs KMS integration details and data residency confirmation.
